INSERT INTO silver_iot_clean
  (sensor_id, location_id, sensor_name, city, latitude, longitude,
   pollutant, value, unit, datetime_utc, source)
VALUES
  ('{{$json["sensor_id"]}}',
   {{$json["location_id"] !== null ? $json["location_id"] : 'NULL'}},
   {{$json["sensor_name"] ? "'" + $json["sensor_name"].replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL'}},
   {{$json["city"] ? "'" + $json["city"].replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL'}},
   {{$json["latitude"]  !== null ? $json["latitude"]  : 'NULL'}},
   {{$json["longitude"] !== null ? $json["longitude"] : 'NULL'}},
   '{{$json["pollutant"]}}',
   {{$json["value"]}},
   '{{$json["unit"]}}',
   '{{$json["datetime_utc"]}}',
   '{{$json["source"]}}')
ON CONFLICT (sensor_id, pollutant, datetime_utc) DO NOTHING;

UPDATE iot_processing_state
   SET last_line  = (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(_new_last_line_val), last_line)
                     FROM (VALUES ({{$json["_new_last_line"] || 0}})) AS t(_new_last_line_val)),
       updated_at = NOW()
 WHERE pipeline = 'bronze_to_silver';
